title: Zoning text change for Sojourner Truth-Mapes Rezoning, Bronx
summary: This application would amend the city's Zoning Resolution to establish a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Area for the Sojourner Truth-Mapes Rezoning in the Bronx. It affects Community District 6 and Council District 15. The request was submitted by 2136 Crotona Parkway Housing Development Fund Corporation.
